name: Fuwari
source:
Fuwari is a strange and mysterious girl who often plays in the park. Seems to be very happy, but she seems unreal...

[spoiler]Her real identity is Tachibana Kaju (橘 花珠), she was the big sister of the [url=https://vndb.org/c1529]real Fuwari[/url] and died in the same accident that put her little sister in a coma.[/spoiler]
